rationale.address_space: Finite 2 TiB retains headroom above measured full V8 reserve ~1.35 TiB; this is not the resident memory budget. Small finite limits cause reservation failure or smaller fallback reservations.
rationale.memory: A3 has 15.5 GiB physical RAM; 2 GiB service tree budget with 1.5 GiB reclaim threshold leaves host headroom. Synthetic native peak ~62 MiB is not a production workload sizing guarantee.
rationale.swap: Zero job swap prevents the test or candidate from displacing host workloads into swap.
rationale.tasks: 64 tasks includes threads and gateway overhead; kernel pids accounting governs descendants regardless of sessions or real UID.
rationale.cpu: 150 percent is 1.5 CPU equivalents on a four-CPU host; per-process 300/301 CPU seconds remains complementary.
rationale.timeout: Retain existing 900 second wall deadline, 128 descriptors, zero cores, bounded streams and 4 MiB private SQLite file allowance. Systemd kills the entire service on OOM/stop.
